import html from typing import List # Example template (replace with the actual one used in your application) USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author_name}

{content}
{tags}
""" def create_post_html( author_name: str, post_title: str, content: str, post_tags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str Name of the user who posted. post_title : str Title/headline of the post. content : str Main body text of the post. post_tags : List[str] Tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string ready to be served. """ # Escape all user‑supplied values safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # Preserve newlines # Build tags string: each tag wrapped in , escaped safe_tags = "" for tag in post_tags: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tags += f'{escaped_tag} ' # Trim trailing space and insert into template formatted = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=safe_author, title=safe_title, content=safe_content, tags=safe_tags.strip() ) return formatted
